name: Eight Off Solitaire
description: Eight Off is a sophisticated and highly winnable solitaire card game that served as a direct precursor to the ubiquitous FreeCell. Its defining feature is the namesake eight 'free cells' (reserves)â€”twice the number found in its more famous descendant. However, this extra mobility is balanced by a stricter building rule: cards in the tableau must be built down by the CORRECT SUIT, rather than alternating colors. content.text: Eight Off is a sophisticated and highly winnable solitaire card game that served as a direct precursor to the ubiquitous FreeCell. Its defining feature is the namesake eight 'free cells' (reserves)â€”twice the number found in its more famous descendant. However, this extra mobility is balanced by a stricter building rule: cards in the tableau must be built down by the CORRECT SUIT, rather than alternating colors. This makes Eight Off a pure game of logic and strategy where almost every deal can be solved with perfect planning.

Eight Off rose to prominence in the mid-20th century as part of the family of solitaire games that utilize 'cells' for temporary storage. It is often credited with inspiring Paul Alfille's creation of FreeCell in 1978.
One player only. Eight Off is a patience (solitaire) game played by a single person; there are no opponents or partners.
Single standard 52-card deck; all cards dealt face up into eight tableau columns and four reserve cells at the start.
Standard deck and a playing surface; no other equipment required.
Deal face up: six cards to each of eight tableau columns, and the remaining four cards into the first four reserve (free) cells.
